name: LDM Lightbox for Gallery and Image Blocks
author: lizdmukami

sections.description:
Gutenberg Gallery Lightbox adds a modern fullscreen image viewing experience to native WordPress Gutenberg Gallery Blocks and Image Blocks.

Created by Liz Mukami, a WordPress Developer based in Nairobi, Kenya.

Features:

  • Automatic lightbox support for Gutenberg Gallery Blocks
  • Automatic support for Gutenberg Image Blocks
  • Fullscreen image viewing
  • Previous and next image navigation
  • Keyboard arrow controls
  • ESC key close support
  • Responsive mobile-friendly layout
  • No shortcode required
  • No settings page required
  • No frontend branding added

Install and activate the plugin and enjoy a seamless image viewing experience throughout your website.

Author Portfolio:
https://lizdmukami.github.io/Liz-Wambeti-Portfolio/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Create or edit a Gutenberg gallery.
  4. Click any image to open the lightbox.

No setup required.
sections.faq:
Does this work with existing galleries?

Yes. Existing Gutenberg galleries automatically receive lightbox functionality after activation.

Does it support keyboard navigation?

Yes. Use:

  • Left Arrow
  • Right Arrow
  • Escape

Does it add external links or branding?

No.
